Founded in 2014 by Dr. Christopher Richard, G7 CR Technologies has evolved into a trusted digital transformation partner delivering cloud, data, AI, security, and managed services to customers worldwide.
Today, G7 CR Technologies is proudly part of Noventiq Global, a leading global digital transformation and cybersecurity solutions provider with operations across multiple regions and deep partnerships with hyperscalers and technology leaders. As part of the Noventiq group, G7 CR combines its strong engineering expertise, customer-centric delivery model, and innovation-led culture with Noventiq’s global scale, governance, and enterprise-grade capabilities — while continuing its mission to create exceptional value for customers and their businesses through cutting-edge technologies, industry-aligned solutions, and cloud-first consulting and managed services.
